item.tetra.scroll.blade_tetra.edge_treat: Unlocks Hamaguri, Flat, Thin, and Plain Edge work when opened near a workbench.

[Edge Polishing Notes]

No edge geometry is the sole answer.

Hamaguri trades speed for endurance, Flat trades endurance for power, and Thin pushes both damage and speed more aggressively.

Restore a Plain Edge before choosing anew.
item.tetra.scroll.blade_tetra.forging_tr: Unlocks Kobuse, Hon-sanmai, Shihozume, and normalization when opened near a workbench.

[Blade Construction Record]

Composite construction strengthens a blade at the cost of integrity.

Kobuse favors endurance, Hon-sanmai balances damage and endurance, and Shihozume pursues strength with a heavier rhythm.

Annealing returns the blade to a normalized structure.
item.tetra.scroll.blade_tetra.assembly_t: Unlocks Precision Nakago Fit, Rigid Assembly, and Standard Assembly work near a workbench.

[Fitting Compendium]

The bond between blade and handle shapes the sword's response.

Precision fitting favors control, while rigid assembly favors endurance.

Disassemble and refit the handle to restore its standard assembly.

tooltip.blade_tetra.style.common_form: Common form: styles only replace the ordinary grounded opener; sneaking directional and aerial attacks still use the Orthodox routes.
style.blade_tetra.standard.description: Method: use Resharped's complete grounded chain, sneaking directional techniques, and aerial attacks, shifting freely with the situation.
style.blade_tetra.standard.tradeoff: Tradeoff: no specialized bias; ideal for learning the foundation and answering complicated fights.
style.blade_tetra.iaido.description: Method: settle the sheath and draw from the ideal spacing of roughly 2–4 blocks; a forward Air Trick can empower the approach, then a backward Air Trick disengages and resheathes.
style.blade_tetra.iaido.tradeoff: Tradeoff: point-blank pressure or taking a hit breaks focus; deflecting within the first 2 draw ticks greatly reduces damage, prevents knockback and preserves stance.
style.blade_tetra.rengeki.description: Method: use the wakizashi's speed to sustain multi-hit chains and keep pressure while moving between one target and a group.
style.blade_tetra.rengeki.tradeoff: Tradeoff: lower damage per hit; repeatedly breaking the chain wastes its speed advantage.
style.blade_tetra.dangaku.description: Method: alternate cleave and sweep; the armored cleave smashes, knocks back, and breaks stance, while the sweep covers a broad frontal area.
style.blade_tetra.dangaku.tradeoff: Tradeoff: powerful against guarded foes and groups, but its weightier rhythm rewards choosing the next cut deliberately.
tetra.module.slashblade/katana_blade.des: [Draw · Burst] A precise single-target cycle built around settling the sheath, a powerful draw, and disengaging to resheathe. A forward Air Trick empowers the draw; sneaking directional and aerial attacks still return to the common form.
tetra.module.slashblade/orthodox_blade.d: [Balanced · Foundation] Preserves Resharped's complete grounded chain, sneaking directional techniques, and aerial attacks without a specialized bias.
[Combo · Pressure] Trades damage per hit for faster, sustained multi-hit pressure against one target or a group; sneaking directional and aerial attacks still return to the common form.
tetra.module.slashblade/nodachi_blade.de: [Stance Break · Sweep] An armored, knockback cleave breaks stance while the alternating sweep clears a broad frontal area. Its weightier rhythm rewards choosing each cut; aerial attacks still return to the common form.

lore.blade_tetra.nbt_sage.title: NBT Sage
lore.blade_tetra.nbt_sage.page:
[Untitled Ink]

This blade carries far more than edge and sheath.

When you learn to read it, it begins reading you.

Behind the ink linger overlapping traces of components, materials, honing, and inherited legacies.
lore.blade_tetra.nbt_sage.completed: Let the same blade experience all eight component slots, including fuller and inscription; carry three distinct blade materials, any saya skin, and five honing steps. It must hold both Hundred-Forged and Myriad Forms while its wielder has completed at least three legacies. Irrelevant NBT can never substitute for these milestones.
lore.blade_tetra.shoshin.title: Shoshin
lore.blade_tetra.shoshin.page:
[Shoshin]

An iron katana, its first form unchanged.

Preserve every original component and survive fifty battles. Repair and honing do not betray the beginning.
lore.blade_tetra.shoshin.completed: Begin with the starter iron katana and preserve its exact blade, handle, guard, sheath, habaki, and pommel construction, with no fuller or inscription. Claim fifty kills in this form. Repairs and honing remain allowed.
lore.blade_tetra.bairen.title: Bairen
lore.blade_tetra.bairen.page:
[Bairen]

Break and reforge, three times made keen; change its steel, hone it, then fight once more.

A blade that never changes cannot be called hundred-forged.
lore.blade_tetra.bairen.completed: Break and restore the same blade three times, change its blade material at least once, and hone it four times. Claim one more kill after every condition is met to inherit Hundred-Forged.
lore.blade_tetra.bansho.title: Bansho
lore.blade_tetra.bansho.page:
[Bansho]

One blade, three paths: lightning draw, dancing tide, mountain-breaking fall.

Leave the signature mark of every style upon the same blade.
lore.blade_tetra.bansho.completed: With the same physical blade, land Iaido's draw, Rengeki's seventh sequence, and Dangaku's heavy cleave. When all three paths leave their mark, the blade inherits Myriad Forms.
lore.blade_tetra.raikiri.title: Raikiri
lore.blade_tetra.raikiri.page:
[Raikiri]

Purple lightning for its sheath, a conductive heart for its bones.

Bear heaven's bolt, then use an ultimate art to claim a final cut before the storm passes.
lore.blade_tetra.raikiri.completed: Apply the Purple Lightning saya pattern and install at least one conductive component. Bear a natural bolt in an open storm, perform a successful SA within sixty seconds, then kill within five seconds to earn Raikiri. The rite is completed only once; afterward, its legacy remains active while inscribed and unbroken. Attacks conduct wounds through nearby enemies, conductive parts and water extend the circuit, and Slash Arts cause overload.
lore.blade_tetra.akatsuki.title: Akatsuki
lore.blade_tetra.akatsuki.page:
[Akatsuki]

Blood crystal in the blade, crimson moon upon the sheath.

When killing intent is full, offer an ultimate finishing cut beneath an unobstructed full moon.
lore.blade_tetra.akatsuki.completed: Awaken the soul inscription with a blood crystal, apply the Akatsuki saya pattern, and reach fifty kills. Beneath an unobstructed full moon, perform a successful SA and kill within five seconds to awaken Yokai Blade: Akatsuki. The rite is completed only once; changing the saya art afterward does not erase its legacy.
lore.blade_tetra.kyouka.title: Kyouka Suigetsu
lore.blade_tetra.kyouka.page:
[Water Moon Without Trace]

Moon above, reflection below.

Let a mirrored blade draw three times without blood touching its bearer; truth and illusion will exchange places.
lore.blade_tetra.kyouka.completed: Apply the Mirror Blossom saya pattern to an Iaido blade with an awakened proudsoul-sphere inscription and a reflective blade material. Stand in water beneath the open night sky, land three precise draws without taking damage, and kill with the third to awaken Kyouka Suigetsu. The rite is completed only once; its ability still favors Iaido afterward.
lore.blade_tetra.senbonzakura.title: Senbonzakura
lore.blade_tetra.senbonzakura.page:
[Dew on a Thousand Branches]

A short edge hides spring beneath a sheath of fallen petals.

At dawn in a cherry grove, let sixteen cuts flow unbroken, untouched, and true; then bid the last foe farewell with the art of the soul.
lore.blade_tetra.senbonzakura.completed: Fit a wakizashi with a sakura-crystal inscription and Sakura Fubuki saya art. In a cherry grove, land sixteen uninterrupted Rengeki hits without taking damage, then perform a Slash Art and kill within five seconds at dawn. The rite is completed only once. Afterward, two Rengeki hits or one direct kill forms a mark, up to three for thirty seconds; the next successful Slash Art hit turns every mark into four seeking petal blades.

dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.intro1: Mikage: Another sword has followed the vermilion seal to this gate.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.intro2: Mikage: If you seek the secret beyond it, show me a cut worthy of crossing worlds.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.akatsuki: Mikage: ...Akatsuki. So my foolish apprentice entrusted her moon to you.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.begin: Mikage: Draw. Beneath this gate, names are decided by the blade.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.phase2: Mikage: The gate remembers every sword ghost it has buried.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.phase3: Mikage: Then witness the cut Akatsuki never mastered—Boundary Flash.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.victory: Mikage: Take the scroll and my remaining sword-soul. Cross the boundary in your own name.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.torii_sweep_: Mikage: Find your path through the gate formation.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.cage_guard: Mikage: Good. Your blade has not yielded.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.defeat1: Mikage: Courage alone cannot carry you beyond this gate.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.defeat2: Mikage: Go back. Forge your blade anew.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.defeat3: Mikage: Akatsuki chose you, but you have yet to give your own answer.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.reminiscence: Mikage: You returned wearing that broken mask... So you still have a question to ask.
Mikage: Good. This time, I will not hold back for Akatsuki's sake.
Mikage: I remember your blade now. Next time, you need not return as a challenger.

dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.visitor.intr: And this time, you are not holding your blade. It seems you remembered what I told you.
Do not just stand there. If you are not here to challenge me, sit and talk with me for a while.
What do you want to ask? If I know the answer, I will tell you.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.visitor.topi: What do you want to ask? If I know the answer, I will tell you.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.visitor.echo: That was no illusion. It was a memory preserved by the mask. The person you met there was the person I used to be.
You won, and that memory reached its end. When you think of it again, you no longer need to see yourself as a challenger.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.visitor.mask: The mask once remembered nothing but battle. Now, it remembers you as well.
As long as you bring it with you, the gate will know you are not an intruder. For you, it is something like a key.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.visitor.akat: Akatsuki was the last disciple I accepted. When she first came here, even the blade in her hands was broken.
Yet she looked me in the eye and asked, quite seriously, whether someone without a home could make a home of the sword.
She learned quickly, and she was very good at causing trouble. Even when she was injured, she always wanted to draw her blade for someone else first.
Later, she chose to leave this place. She did not betray me, and I did not cast her out. She had simply found the path she wanted to follow.
Now that Akatsuki travels with you, do not think of her as nothing more than a powerful weapon.
Listen, now and then, to what she is trying to tell you. That child... was never very good at saying things directly.
dialogue.blade_tetra.mikage.visitor.mika: Mikage is not my true name. It is the title used by the guardian of the boundary gate.
I was once an ordinary person. I could be hurt, I grew tired, and I forged blades for others in the workshop beyond the gate.
But that was a very long time ago. The real me died long ago. What remains here is only a memory preserved by the gate.
All I knew then was how to receive challengers and fight them, again and again.
You defeated me, but you did not destroy me. That is why I can sit here and speak with you now.
I do not know whether someone like me can truly be called alive.
But at the very least, speaking with you now is my own choice.

lore.blade_tetra.named_blade_record.cove:
Named Blade Record

— A master smith's gift —

'When you find a famed blade, do not rush to copy its edge.
Study the saya first, then the hilt.'

This volume records imprinting and legacy fusion.
lore.blade_tetra.named_blade_record.impr:
[Named-blade imprinting]

Place a supported named blade on a blade stand directly above a Tetra workbench.

Hold a blank imprint scroll and sneak-right-click the workbench to begin studying it.

Failure can damage the original blade. Proud Soul materials can improve the odds or protect it.
lore.blade_tetra.named_blade_record.orth:
[Orthodox legacy]

A successful study unlocks the named blade's saya and complete hilt fittings.

Your Tetra blade material remains your own.

Matching saya and hilt fittings form imprint affinity and inherit the source blade's registered SA or SE.
lore.blade_tetra.named_blade_record.fusi:
[Legacy fusion]

Some fittings from different named blades can be tuned together, awakening techniques that neither source blade possessed.

Saya and hilt order matters. Reversing the same pair can produce a different result.

Confirmed combinations follow.
tetra.improvement.blade_tetra/legacy_fus: Muramasa's saya releases and Doutanuki's hilt answers. After a short wind-up, a heavy vertical cut applies bounded compensation against the target's armor and toughness.

The Sange saya releases while the Yamato hilt answers. A brief void domain reduces and stores hostile pressure, then returns it as summoned swords; Residual Bloom remains available during the domain cooldown.
tetra/schematic/slashblade/legacy_fusion: Attune the Sange saya and Yamato hilt into a defensive domain legacy.
tetra.improvement.blade_tetra/legacy_fus: Agito's saya releases and Yuzuki Tsukumo's hilt answers. A vertical wave and horizontal phantom drive cross into a finishing seal.
Tagayasan's saya releases and Koseki's hilt answers. Three vertical phantom drives descend over the locked target while a fourth launches from the wielder; hits inflict five seconds of Wither.
Black Fox's saya releases and Sange's hilt answers. SlashBlade's native piercing dash opens the attack, then three summoned swords pin the struck target from separate angles.
